title: group_oscore vectors: wrong spec pointer (18.6) and missing wrap-successor/window-accept pins
description: test/vectors/group_oscore_key.json header cites spec/12-apps.md Section 18.6 (Check-In/Roll Call — wrong); the operative rekey text is 18.8.2 (spec/12-apps.md:1211-1220); module and tests cite 18.8.5 (thin key-resource section, no epoch semantics). Vectors also do not pin: the wrap successor (epoch 1, not 0 — only wraps_at=4294967295 is given), the ACCEPT side of the [current, current+1] window (rejections only), or grace-vs-epoch interplay. An implementer following the JSON alone cannot reproduce the module's behavior. Fix pointers, add wrap-successor + window-accept + grace vectors AFTER the epoch-semantics bead settles the semantics.
